sections.title: Hyrulean Adventure
sections.note: Eight levels of three stages, in order. Each stage needs 2,000 Force Gems to break its dark barrier.

items.name: Lake Hylia
items.howTo: Kaepora Gaebora explains the Force Gems. Cross the small lakes and rivers of eastern Hyrule, defeat the Chief Soldier at the end, and break the dark barrier with 2,000 Force Gems.
items.notes: Items: Boomerang, Fire Rod. Zelda Dungeon calls the Chief Soldier the stage boss, Zelda Wiki a sub-boss; StrategyWiki names him the Squad Leader.

items.name: Cave of No Return
items.howTo: A long, dark labyrinth: light the way with the Lamp. The Lonely Old Man gives hints about working together. Shadow Link waits at the end.
items.notes: Items: Lamp, Bow. Clearing it in multiplayer brings the first Tingle's Tower invitation (Bucking Bronco).

items.name: Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: Fight through the castle's soldiers and its four-podium weapon room, then defeat Phantom Ganon to free the Blue Maiden.
items.notes: Items: Bow, Bombs.

items.name: The Coast
items.howTo: A shoreline full of Octoroks, Zoras and Sand Crabs. A Great Fairy in a cave below a whirlpool upgrades the Slingshot for fighting off ten Zoras. Dodge Shadow Link's Giant Bombs and defeat Manhandla.
items.notes: Items: Bombs, Giant Bomb, Slingshot (Lv2).

items.name: Village of the Blue Maiden
items.howTo: No enemies: help the villagers with their tasks and use the Moon Pearl to enter the Dark World and find the missing children. A pair of Shadow Links is the boss.
items.notes: Items: Pegasus Boots, Lamp, Shovel, Roc's Feather, Fire Rod (offered instead of a Heart Container), Moon Pearl. Unlocks Cucco Wranglers in Tingle's Tower.

items.name: Eastern Temple
items.howTo: Trap-filled halls, chests that hold Big Bombs and a vine-covered maze with bombable walls. Take the Big Key to Stone Arrghus and free the Yellow Maiden.
items.notes: Items: Slingshot, Lamp, Bow, Bombs, Boomerang, Moon Pearl.

items.name: Death Mountain Foothills
items.howTo: The Yellow Maiden points you up the mountain. Ride the Old-Timer's fire-proof Moving House against the Deadrocks, find the way through Hebra's Hill, and beat the Chief Soldier one last time.
items.notes: Items: Bow, Boomerang, Magic Hammer, Bombs, Bombos and Quake Medallions.

items.name: The Mountain Path
items.howTo: Help the Gorons: put out Shadow Link's fires with Water Pots from the caves and climb above the clouds to fight the Helmaroc King.
items.notes: Items: Roc's Feather, Magic Hammer, Boomerang (Lv2), Bombs; Zelda Wiki also lists the Bow, Fire Rod and Pegasus Boots. Unlocks Hammer Tag in Tingle's Tower.

items.name: Tower of Flames
items.howTo: Climb the lava-filled tower. A Goron near the top who dropped his Bombs explains how to beat the Dodongos; feed them Bombs and free the Green Maiden.
items.notes: Items: Slingshot, Boomerang, Roc's Feather, Bow, Bombs; Zelda Wiki also lists the Lamp.

items.name: The Field
items.howTo: Escort Malon, who has one heart, through the cannon fire to Lon Lon Ranch; Talon then lends you the horses. Defeat the Big Dark Stalfos (Blue Knight) for its Royal Jewel.
items.notes: Items: Boomerang, Pegasus Boots (Lv2), Bow, Shovel, Bombos Medallion. Gohma appears as a sub-boss. If Malon falls, every Link does.

items.name: The Swamp
items.howTo: Avoid the poison pools and shelter from Shadow Link's Giant Bombs in the caves. Dampé tells of the Dark Mirror; lift the trees with the Power Bracelet and defeat the Big Poe.
items.notes: Items: Roc's Feather, Bow, Lamp, Bombs, Moon Pearl. Unlocks Monster Hunting in Tingle's Tower.

items.name: Infiltration of Hyrule Castle
items.howTo: A stealth stage: keep out of the searchlights (swim under the moat), and if caught, hook the cell key from the pot across the hall with the Boomerang. Defeat the Big Poe and free the White Maiden.
items.notes: Items: Magic Hammer, Boomerang, Bow, Lamp, Moon Pearl.

items.name: Lost Woods
items.howTo: The White Maiden warps you into the Forest of Dark to look for the Dark Mirror. Trade with the Deku Scrubs for a Power Bracelet, follow the skulls underground and defeat the giant Gohma.
items.notes: Items: Roc's Feather, Lamp, Bow, Shovel (Lv2), Moon Pearl, Bombs.

items.name: Kakariko Village
items.howTo: Catch every thief hiding around the village and throw them into the Old Man's fence. Give another Old Man a Cucco for a Power Bracelet, then defeat the Big Dark Stalfos (Green Knight) for its Royal Jewel.
items.notes: Items: Fire Rod, Boomerang, Shovel, Bombs. Unlocks Volley, By Golly in Tingle's Tower.

items.name: Temple of Darkness
items.howTo: The Dark Mirror's temple. The Mirror has been stolen; defeat the stronger Phantom Ganon (with its clones) and free the Red Maiden.
items.notes: Items: Bow, Magic Hammer, Slingshot, Pegasus Boots, Boomerang, Lamp, Moon Pearl, Bombs. Zelda Wiki counts four Phantom Ganons.

items.name: Desert of Doubt
items.howTo: Get the Gerudo leader's permission to cross. In the sandstorms, "oppose the winds": take the paths the wind blows from, as the early tablet says. Defeat the Big Dark Stalfos (Red Knight) for its Royal Jewel.
items.notes: Items: Pegasus Boots (Lv2), Moon Pearl. A Zuna sells a healing Sand Rub for 100 Force Gems; another runs a Treasure Chest Game.

items.name: Desert Temple
items.howTo: A switch fills the temple with sand: dig out Force Gems and keys with the Magic Hammer, leaving and re-entering mid-way. Defeat Shadow Link at the end.
items.notes: Items: Bow (a chest holds the Lv2 Bow), Magic Hammer, Moon Pearl. A Beamos's beam can hit the switch for a Blue Bracelet. Unlocks Mole Melee in Tingle's Tower.

items.name: Pyramid
items.howTo: Puzzles among the Gibdos and Shadow Link's Giant Bombs. The Big Key opens a chest with a 1,000 Force Gem. Defeat the Big Moldorm to free the Purple Maiden.
items.notes: Items: Slingshot, Pegasus Boots (Lv2), Lamp, Bombs, Moon Pearl. The Trident is missing: Ganon has taken it.

items.name: Frozen Hyrule
items.howTo: Melt snow walls, snowballs and frozen Force Gems with the Fire Rod, and shelter in holes from the blizzards. Get past Manhandla, then defeat the Big Dark Stalfos (Purple Knight) for the last Royal Jewel.
items.notes: Items: Pegasus Boots, Fire Rod, Bombs, Quake Medallion, Moon Pearl.

items.name: Temple of Ice
items.howTo: Slide Bomb Flowers across the ice and melt Ice Blocks with the Fire Rod; upgrade it to Lv2 to make the blocks you need for the switches. Defeat two Ball and Chain Soldiers.
items.notes: Items: Boomerang, Fire Rod (Lv2), Roc's Feather, Bomb Flowers. Zelda Dungeon calls it the Ice Temple. Unlocks Monster Hunting Returns in Tingle's Tower.

items.name: Tower of Winds
items.howTo: The four Royal Jewels open the tower, played almost all side-on. Defeat Frostare at the top to free Princess Zelda.
items.notes: Items: Slingshot, Roc's Feather, Fire Rod, Bombs.

items.name: Realm of the Heavens
items.howTo: Above the clouds, with pitfalls everywhere and colour tiles only the matching Link can cross. Beat the Ball and Chain Soldier's flaming weapon midway and the Big Dodongo at the end.
items.notes: Items: Roc's Feather, Magic Hammer, Pegasus Boots, Bombs (a chest holds Lv2 Bombs), Moon Pearl.

items.name: The Dark Cloud
items.howTo: Side-on at first, then two routes: a hidden-spike maze (reveal the spikes with the Magic Hammer) or the Slingshot platform past four barriers. Both end with the last fight against Shadow Link, and the Dark Mirror is recovered.
items.notes: Items: Bow, Magic Hammer, Slingshot, Lamp, Bombs, Moon Pearl. Unlocks the Bonus Course in Tingle's Tower.

items.name: Palace of Winds
items.howTo: Vaati's palace, with four Moon Pearls on the way. Defeat Vaati, then Ganon.
items.reward: The ending; the Dark World Shadow Battle arenas
items.notes: Items: Boomerang, Bow, Pegasus Boots (Lv2), Magic Hammer (Lv2), Roc's Feather, Bombs. Zelda Wiki files the Ganon fight under the Tower of Winds; Zelda Dungeon and speedrun.com end this stage with it.
